duration.text: The Computer Science and Technology at Donghua University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5555 USD/per year ￥ 40000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2.Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3.Bachelor's degree diplomaGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4.Transcript of undergraduate school5.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program)Level 5 or above6.Two recommendation letters(optional)From professor,associate professor or equivalents.7.Photocopy of 1st page to 7th page of your valid passportConcerning about your entering/exiting any other countries. If students have never been to any other country, please give us the copy version of passport from the 1st page to the 7th page which demonstrated that have never been to any other country.

requirements.text: 1.Applicant should be less than the age of 402.Applicant should hold Bachelor's degree in correlated disciplines 3.HSK level 5 or above 4.Be in good health condition
